dialogues.speaker: Argalia
dialogues.text: Should I redo my storage plan for the tableware again...?

dialogues.speaker: Argalia
dialogues.text: Well, I'm currently considering how to arrange the various utensils we use here at the hotel.

dialogues.speaker: Argalia
dialogues.text: I used to place them in a rack close to the outside, which would make them easy to take and use.

dialogues.speaker: Argalia
dialogues.text: But Lynette once knocked them over when she was invited to perform here, causing them to clatter to the ground, shattering on impact.

dialogues.speaker: Argalia
dialogues.text: Fortunately, Lynette wasn't hurt — everyone would surely have been grieved if her beautiful face was injured by mistake...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Eh? There's another one of you...

dialogues.speaker: Argalia
dialogues.text: Ah, you must've met my elder sister downstairs, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Argalia
dialogues.text: We're twins, and most people can't tell us apart by appearance. We sound very different, though, so we get exposed the moment we open our mouths.

dialogues.speaker: Argalia
dialogues.text: My sister speaks slow, but she's a careful sort. If you need help on the first floor of the restaurant, just leave it to her.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I happen to agree with you.

dialogues.speaker: Argalia
dialogues.text: Back then, Lynette didn't blame us for not taking care of the tableware better. She even apologized, saying that this sort of thing always happens to her...

dialogues.speaker: Argalia
dialogues.text: Maybe she only said that so we wouldn't feel too awkward about things. I mean, she seems rather cold, but she's actually super modest and polite!
